announcements.headline: EQS-News: Symrise delivered strong volume-driven organic sales growth in Q3 2026 and reaffirms full-year outlook
announcements.insight: Strong volume-driven growth in Q3 2026 validates Symrise's post-DSM-Firmenich integration strategy and counters sector-wide margin pressures, reinforcing confidence in the reaffirmed full-year outlook.

announcements.headline: EQS-News: Symrise expands global production platform for sustainable musk fragrance ingredient
announcements.insight: This expansion reinforces Symrise's strategic pivot toward high-margin sustainable ingredients, aligning with the broader FMCG sector's demand for eco-certified supply chains and mitigating regulatory risks associated with synthetic musks.

announcements.headline: EQS-CMS: Symrise AG: Release of a capital market information
EQS-News: Symrise reports solid H1 2026 performance with accelerating growth momentum in Q2
announcements.insight: Symrise's accelerating Q2 growth in H1 2026 signals successful margin recovery and demand resilience within the competitive fragrance and flavour sector, reinforcing its premium positioning against peers facing volume headwinds.

announcements.headline: EQS-News: Symrise signs a put option agreement to acquire Floral Concept
announcements.insight: Symrise's acquisition of Floral Concept via put option signals a targeted expansion into the natural ingredients segment, aligning with broader consumer demand for clean-label and sustainable sourcing in the fragrance and flavor industry.
